{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its mix of heavy riffs and melody fits my interest in In Flames and Disturbed.
ItemID: NA; Title: Believe       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After Ten Thousand Fists, I would choose another Disturbed album for its heavy grooves and strong vocals.
ItemID: NA; Title: Dysfunction; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The darker hard-rock sound appeals, but I would prioritize albums connected to my most recent listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Meteora; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic hooks and aggression fit parts of my history, but I want something more brooding today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Mer De Noms       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Coming from 10.000 Days, I would try Maynard's vocals in a more compact, atmospheric rock setting.
ItemID: NA; Title: Opiate       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My recent Tool listening makes their earlier, rawer material a compelling next choice.
ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its abrasive percussion and stripped-down approach are less appealing than the melodic or atmospheric heaviness I want now.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Fever You Can't Sweat Out; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The theatrical pop-oriented sound does not fit my current mood for heavier rock and metal.
ItemID: NA; Title: God Hates Us All       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its aggression connects with my heavier listening, but relentless thrash is not my first choice this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Faceless       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy grooves fit my taste, though Believe and the Tool-related albums interest me more right now."}
